modern: Consider that men will do the same things all the same, even if you should burst.
original: [Consider] that men will do the same things nevertheless, even though thou shouldst burst.
notification: Consider that men will do the same things all the same, even if you should burst.
notification_original: [Consider] that men will do the same things nevertheless, even though thou shouldst burst.

explained.summary: People will carry on doing what they do even if you burst with frustration. Fuming changes nothing about them and only harms you. It’s a blunt reminder to stop expecting your anger to fix other people.
explained.today: Drivers will still cut in, a relative will still post the same opinions, and a flatmate will still leave dishes in the sink, however much you seethe about it.
